nodes.description: Build a city's baseline elements from the CFC data lake with exe_reimagina's rules: INEGI blocks and census, cadastral lots, normativa, Open Buildings heights, the city's amenity layers (normalized into the amenities file) and the DENUE. Blocks are keyed by CVEGEO; lots by their cadastral key. Each DENUE record is an amenity or an establishment by the SCIAN crosswalk; with the amenities file's, they go to the nearest lot within 50 m as a point at its center, and each lot's land use follows from what it holds.

nodes.description: A city's streets as right_of_way elements, one per street of its street network (reimagina_street_network), with streetlights from the block faces near each street and a bike lane band where the street's midpoint lies near one of the city's bike lanes (sources.street_lighting, sources.bike_lanes). With sources.streets.params.refine, the vehicular streets are fitted to the cadastre's lots instead: one right of way per stretch from intersection to intersection, centred between the lot fronts, with bands of the measured width and the lighting and bike lane matches scaled to it; pedestrian streets stay as above.

nodes.description: Build a city's baseline from the data lake (reimagina_baseline) and write it into an existing baseline scenario of a project: elements, state and attribute values of blocks, lots, amenities, establishments and streets (right_of_way, from reimagina_baseline_streets; left out when the city has none), in one transaction. Existing elements are reused unchanged; running it again replaces the scenario's rows. Missing attribute_catalog and indicator_catalog rows are added first; existing ones are left as they are and must be active. Compute indicators afterwards with reimagina_scenario_write.
